parameters.query: WITH request AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS body), calculated AS (SELECT body->>'order_id' AS order_id, sum(i.quantity)::integer AS item_count, sum(i.quantity::bigint * i.unit_cents)::integer AS total_cents FROM request CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(body->'items') AS i(sku text, quantity integer, unit_cents integer) GROUP BY body HAVING bool_and(i.quantity > 0 AND i.unit_cents >= 0 AND i.sku IS NOT NULL)) INSERT INTO automation.receipts (order_id, item_count, total_cents) SELECT order_id, item_count, total_cents FROM calculated RETURNING order_id, item_count, total_cents, recorded_at
